principle: one pack router, canonical artifact owner per scope, and one final task list; upstream skills remain independent and portable

precedence.using-sdlc-skills: Only pack-level router. It classifies the work and selects a workflow; upstream skills do not install/activate a competing router by default.
precedence.pm-product-spec: Owns product-level PRD/product intent. It may summarize candidate stories but does not own detailed Story/AC records.
precedence.pm-user-story: Owns the detailed Story/Acceptance Criteria section in the canonical feature spec. User story content must not be duplicated into another authoritative file.
precedence.pm-spec-quality-audit: Owns semantic review of PRD/spec/Story documents; findings are severity-rated, not reduced to an arbitrary score.
precedence.requirements-engineering: Owns formal system SRS/FR/NFR and initial requirement rows/IDs only when formal requirements/traceability are warranted.
precedence.software-architecture: Owns system architecture overview; ADRs, API contracts and detailed feature design are separate responsibilities.
precedence.planning-and-task-breakdown: Owns the final tasks list for a feature. Other workflow/skill content may inform the plan but must not create a competing task list.
precedence.verification-before-completion: Requires fresh observable evidence before making completion/pass claims; it does not replace acceptance criteria or independent review.
precedence.systematic-debugging: Default pack debugging skill. Stabilize/reproduce and identify root cause before changing code.
precedence.webapp-testing: Use Playwright-based tests when the environment supports it. Do not also invoke browser-testing-with-devtools unless the second tool provides distinct required evidence.
precedence.browser-testing-with-devtools: Use browser DevTools/MCP for runtime inspection when that tool is available; do not assume its MCP is installed.
precedence.database-design: Provides schema design, indexing, and migration guidelines. Complements software-architecture by focusing on persistence tier.
precedence.api-contract-testing: Verifies wire-level provider/consumer schema contracts and backward compatibility using local fixtures; does not replace end-to-end web testing.
precedence.auth-implementation-patterns: Designs authentication tokens, session lifecycles, and RBAC/ABAC authorization boundaries; does not replace security code review.
precedence.secrets-management: Secures secrets retrieval, CI credentials, and rotation workflows; does not grant permission to inspect production secrets.
